whatItIs: A free prescription discount card. It is not insurance, needs no sign-up, has no expiry date, and anyone in your household can use it.
whyUseIt: Ask for the price with the card and the price without it, and pay the lower one.
howToUse: Show the pharmacist the card, or read out the BIN, PCN and Group code.
Ask them to run it as a discount card, not as insurance.
Ask what the price is with the card and without it, and pay the lower one.
If they ask for a Member ID, give your 10-digit phone number.

faq.q: Does it work on every drug?
faq.a: Usually yes, but discounts are largest on generics. Always compare.

faq.q: The pharmacy asks for a Member ID. What do I give them?
faq.a: Your own 10-digit phone number, area code first. This card has no personal member number: the pharmacist enters the card's BIN, PCN and Group and your phone number as the Member (Cardholder) ID, and runs it as a discount card, not as insurance.
